description: This PHP source file defines the AttendanceMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for configuring attendance-related menu options in the HRM application. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses a trait for module screen helpers.

classes.name: AttendanceMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the attendance menu in the HRM system by overriding the module with 'time'. Implements the MenuConfigurator interface.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the menu configuration for the given screen, setting the current module to 'time' via the trait method; returns null.
